W.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Sun be-low the ridge / a lens cloud's edge still holds pearl / green then pink then gone); the colour sequence and fading cut land, though lens cloud and pearl colours blur two cloud types.

X.note: Counts 4-7-5 (Pearl-lit they glow / na-cre-ous clouds hold the dusk / long after the sun), so the first line is short; accurately names nacreous clouds and has a nice dusk-holding idea.

Y.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Pearl a-long one edge / the sun gone the cloud holds on / o-ver creak-ing ice); the creaking ice grounds a polar nacreous scene with a surprising sound image, though the cloud is only implied.

Z.note: Counts 5-7-4 (Moth-er of pearl sky / na-cre-ous clouds hold the dusk / long af-ter sun-set), ending a syllable short; mother-of-pearl is stock and it is mostly a weaker twin of X.
